Build Your Own Skill

Turns any workflow you repeat into a complete, working Claude skill file — written out and ready to save.

What it does

Weekly reports, recurring reviews, monthly documents, checklists that live in your head, prompts you keep retyping. Package it once, use it forever.

How to use this in Claude Code

  1. Download and unzip the file.
  2. Move the folder into ~/.claude/skills/
  3. Open Claude Code and describe what you need, or call it by name. No restart needed.

Built for Claude Code, which needs a paid Claude plan.
